metadata.title: Some remarks on robust features of surfaces in 4-space
metadata.abstract: We study robust features of smooth surfaces in 4-space associated with contact with lines and hyperplanes. We investigate the local and multi-local singularities of orthogonal projections and height functions that describe these contacts and their corresponding geometric loci on the surface. At an $A_4$-singularity of a height function, we show that the $A_3$-curve and the $A_1A_2$-curve are generically tangent with contact of order $2$. We further establish criteria for the versality of the families of height functions and orthogonal projections in terms of the regularity of the $B_2$-curve and $S_2$-curve, respectively. Finally, we obtain the $[A_2]$- and $(A_0S_0)_2$-curves arising from multi-local singularities of orthogonal projections and describe their tangency properties at the $B_3$- and $H_3$-singularities.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: 四维空间中曲面接触的稳定奇点结构
analysis.workSummary: 研究 R⁴ 光滑曲面与直线/超平面接触所对应的正交投影、高度函数的局部及多局部奇点。在高度函数 A₄ 奇点处，证明 A₃ 曲线与 A₁A₂ 曲线一般有二阶接触；用 B₂、S₂ 曲线正则性刻画相应函数族的 versality，并分析 B₃、H₃ 点附近多局部投影曲线切触。
techniques: 正交投影及高度函数的奇点理论
多局部奇点与 versal 族
analysis.breakthrough: 把抽象奇点展开条件转为曲面上可识别的轨迹正则性与切触性质。
analysis.limitations: 二阶接触及轨迹描述有一般性/非退化假设；不属于任意曲面的全局分类，也不涉及极小或曲率流结构。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。实际 PDF SHA-256 与本次记录一致；共 24 页，页数核对一致、文本完整提取、无短文本页。标准检索及点写 A.I./A. I.、断行/连字符模型名称（含 Danus）、生成式 AI 用语补检均未观察到作者自身使用披露；不等同确认未使用 AI。

analysis.priorityReason: 经典局部微分几何与奇点理论的细化，属特殊几何次重点。
